title: File Processing Pipeline Profile v1
summary: A module that accepts files, validates them, stores them, extracts or transforms content, and exposes derived artifacts.

integration_points.name: ingest
integration_points.description: Accepted files, validation, storage, security, and processing trigger.

integration_points.name: storage
integration_points.description: Bucket, prefix, object role, access, retention, and lifecycle.

integration_points.name: derived_outputs
integration_points.description: Artifacts, renditions, extracted content, reports, and provenance.

checks: Upload surfaces declare accepted file types, limits, validation, and access rules.
Stored objects declare layout, retention, and deletion behavior.
Derived outputs link to source files and provenance.
Processing failures are represented as inspectable outputs or diagnostics.
Sensitive files have privacy and permission behavior.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for imports, attachments, media pipelines, document processing, and file-derived data.
Treat storage layout and derived artifacts as public integration surfaces.
Report validation, storage, processing outputs, provenance, and deletion behavior.
